concerns.text: Task T009 orchestrates the full pipeline and expects outputs from T012 (hold‑out validation) and T011 (final report). Since T012 and T011 are defined later, T009 would run before its required producer tasks, violating the producer‑before‑consumer ordering.

Task T010 validates all pipeline outputs, including those generated by T011 (final report) and T012 (hold‑out validation). Because T010 is placed before T011 and T012, it would attempt to validate artifacts that do not yet exist, constituting a consumer‑before‑producer ordering error.

Task T011 generates the final markdown report and references the hold‑out validation flag produced by T012. Since T011 appears before T012, it would create a report lacking the required hold‑out validation information, again a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.
